notes.title: New Incremental RPG game just released on Steam!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
After months of hard work, I'm excited to share that my new game, Incremental Town RPG, is finally out! 🏰 ⚔️🏝️🌳🥳

Get it now on Steam 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2895430/Incremental_Town_RPG/
